name: Typography

componentSettings.label: Type Foundations
componentSettings.description: Shared typography controls for families, weights, rhythm, and spacing.

settings.label: Body Font Family
settings.description: Controls the base typeface used by body, paragraph, lead, small text, and non-heading variants that inherit the base family.

settings.label: Heading Font Family
settings.description: Controls the typeface used by variants that explicitly switch to the heading family.

settings.label: Body Font Weight
settings.description: Controls the default font weight for variants that keep the base weight.

settings.label: Medium Font Weight
settings.description: Controls the shared medium emphasis used by title and lead variants.

settings.label: Bold Font Weight
settings.description: Controls the heavier emphasis used by bold and marketing variants.

settings.label: Heading Font Weight
settings.description: Controls the default weight used by heading level variants h1 through h6.

settings.label: Body Line Height
settings.description: Controls the reading line height for variants that keep the base line height.

settings.label: Heading Line Height
settings.description: Controls the shared line height for heading-style variants.

settings.label: Body Letter Spacing
settings.description: Controls the default tracking for variants that inherit the base letter spacing.

settings.label: Heading Letter Spacing
settings.description: Controls the tracking for heading-style variants that use the heading spacing scale.

settings.label: Heading Spacing
settings.description: Controls the vertical spacing inserted between adjacent heading-style variants.

componentSettings.label: Type Scale
componentSettings.description: Shared token-based font sizes used by typography variants.

settings.label: Small Text Size
settings.description: Controls caption, byline, and meta text sizes.

settings.label: Lead and Small Heading Size
settings.description: Controls the shared size used by lead text and the smaller heading level h6.

settings.label: H5 Size
settings.description: Controls the default size used by h5 headings.

settings.label: Subtitle and H4 Size
settings.description: Controls the shared size used by subtitle and h4 variants.

settings.label: Title Size
settings.description: Controls the default size used by title text between h3 and h4.

settings.label: Headline and H3 Size
settings.description: Controls the shared size used by headline and h3 variants.

settings.label: Marketing and H2 Size
settings.description: Controls the shared size used by marketing and h2 variants.

settings.label: H1 Size
settings.description: Controls the default size used by h1 headings.

componentSettings.label: Modifier Overrides
componentSettings.description: Local multiplier controls that let specific typography modifiers scale independently in a single placement.

settings.label: Body Size Multiplier
settings.description: Scales regular body and paragraph text locally without changing the shared type scale.

settings.label: Bold Size Multiplier
settings.description: Scales the bold variant locally without changing other text styles.

settings.label: Lead Size Multiplier
settings.description: Scales lead text locally without changing the shared lead token.

settings.label: Caption Size Multiplier
settings.description: Scales caption text locally without changing the shared small-text token.

settings.label: Byline Size Multiplier
settings.description: Scales byline text locally without changing the shared small-text token.

settings.label: Meta Size Multiplier
settings.description: Scales meta text locally without changing the shared small-text token.

settings.label: Email Size Multiplier
settings.description: Scales email text locally without changing the shared body size.

settings.label: H1 Size Multiplier
settings.description: Scales h1 locally for one placement without changing the global h1 scale.

settings.label: H2 Size Multiplier
settings.description: Scales h2 locally for one placement without changing the global h2 scale.

settings.label: H3 Size Multiplier
settings.description: Scales h3 locally for one placement without changing the global h3 scale.

settings.label: H4 Size Multiplier
settings.description: Scales h4 locally for one placement without changing the global h4 scale.

settings.label: H5 Size Multiplier
settings.description: Scales h5 locally for one placement without changing the global h5 scale.

settings.label: H6 Size Multiplier
settings.description: Scales h6 locally for one placement without changing the global h6 scale.

settings.label: Headline Size Multiplier
settings.description: Scales the headline variant locally without changing the shared display scale.

settings.label: Title Size Multiplier
settings.description: Scales the title variant locally without changing the shared display scale.

settings.label: Subtitle Size Multiplier
settings.description: Scales the subtitle variant locally without changing the shared display scale.

settings.label: Marketing Size Multiplier
settings.description: Scales the marketing variant locally without changing the shared display scale.

description: The Typography component provides a reusable pattern for typography in the interface.
